issues.legal_issue: For an interested person who was absent when a land acquisition award was made and received no notice of it, the limitation period for seeking a reference begins when the person learns the essential contents of the award.
material_facts: The interested persons were not notified of the acquisition and were neither present nor represented when the award was made.
They first sought interim payment without knowing the amount of compensation fixed by the award; that request did not establish knowledge of the award’s essential contents.
They learned the essential contents when they received the compensation payment and applied for a reference within six months of that date.
Their evidence about when they learned the award’s contents was not seriously contradicted.
issues.conclusion: The application for a reference was within time. The appeal was dismissed.
issues.legal_principle: Under section 18, proviso clause (b), of the Land Acquisition Act, 1894, where the applicant was not present or represented when the award was made and did not receive notice under section 12(2), the period in the second part of clause (b) runs from when the award is communicated to the applicant or becomes actually or constructively known. Following Raja Harish Chandra Raj Singh v. The Deputy Land Acquisition Officer, knowledge must concern the essential contents of the award, not merely the fact that an award was made. The Court did not decide whether a court hearing a reference may itself examine whether the reference was timely.

rule.if: land_acquisition_reference_request and applicant_absent_from_award and award_notice_not_received and essential_contents_learned_within_limitation_window

predicates.land_acquisition_reference_request: An interested person sought a court reference to challenge compensation fixed in a compulsory land acquisition award.
predicates.applicant_absent_from_award: The interested person was neither personally present nor represented when the award was made.
predicates.award_notice_not_received: The acquiring authority did not give the interested person notice of the award.
predicates.essential_contents_learned_within_limita: The interested person learned the essential contents of the award sufficiently before applying for a reference to meet the applicable time limit.

issues.definition: When an interested person seeking a land acquisition reference was absent from the award and received no notice, the request is timely if the person learned the award’s essential contents within the applicable time window before applying.
